name: Time Publishing and Media Co., Ltd.
summary: Time Publishing and Media Co., Ltd. publishes various books and periodicals in China. The company operates through Publishing and Distribution; Printing and Reproduction; Material Sales; and Other Business segments. It leases textbooks, editing and publishing general books, periodicals, electronic publications, audio-visual products, digital publications, teaching aids; and provides after-school, campus, educational, and study tour services for schools.
